descriptionChirho: The myrtle tree (Myrtus communis), an evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean and Near East, mentioned in Zechariah's night vision (among myrtle trees in the hollow), in Isaiah's eschatological restoration (replacing briers), and in Nehemiah's Festival of Booths instructions. All six occurrences refer to the same botanical species whether in singular, plural, or with conjunctive prefix. Eng 'myrtle / myrtle trees', spa 'mirto / mirtos', hin 'menhdi ke per', arb 'al-as / as', kor 'hwaseokryu / dogeumyang', swa 'mhadasi / miahadasi'.
